newsitem.title: ICELAND: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ICELAND VS LITHUANIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ICELAND VS LITHUANIA.

text.p: Teams for Iceland and Lithuania in their World Cup European zone group eight qualifier on Wednesday:

Iceland: 1-Kristjan Finnbogason, 4-Sigurdur Jonsson, 7-Gudni Bergsson, 2-Larus Orri Sigurdsson, 11-Eyjolfur Sverrisson, 6-Runar Kristinsson, 3-Thordur Gudjonsson, 5-Sigursteinn Gislason, 10-Arnor Gudjohnsen, 9-Arnar Gunnlaugsson, 8-Bjarki Gunnlaugsson.

Lithuania: 1-Gintaras Stauche, 2-Tomas Ziukus, 3-Andrejus Tereskinas, 4-Giedrius Zutautas, 5-Raimondas Vainoras, 6-Irnantas Stumbrys, 7-Raimondas Zutautas, 8-Vaidotas Slekys, 9-Aidas Treiksaitis, 10-Aurelijus Skarabalius, 11-Edjaras Jankauskas
